reuse.why: Extends the single existing holiday matcher isWeekendOrHoliday and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the yearly match is one extra condition in the one shared predicate.

placement.why: The change lives in shared/schedules.ts, where every holiday check in the tree is decided.

scope.why: A three-line change to the matcher plus two focused tests.

maintainability.why: Simple and central, though day.slice(5) encodes the MM-DD format implicitly rather than naming it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks already go through isWeekendOrHoliday, which the change extends.
